purpose: Preserve branch content in main without regressing canonical files.

files..github/workflows/android-knowledge-brid:
name: Android Knowledge Bridge APK

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - feat/android-knowledge-bridge
    paths:
      - "omega-mobile/android-knowledge-bridge/**"
      - ".github/workflows/android-knowledge-bridge.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "omega-mobile/android-knowledge-bridge/**"
      - ".github/workflows/android-knowledge-bridge.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
      - name: Install Android SDK packages
        shell: bash
        run: |
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses >/dev/null || true
          "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.10.2"
      - name: Build debug APK
        working-directory: omega-mobile/android-knowledge-bridge
        run: gradle --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OMEGA-Knowledge-Bridge-APK
          path: omega-mobile/android-knowledge-bridge/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 7
files.omega-mobile/android-knowledge-bridge/ap:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />

    <application
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:label="OMEGA Knowledge Bridge"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.AppCompat.DayNight.NoActionBar">
        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <service
            android:name=".KnowledgeBridgeService"
            android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync" />
    </application>
</manifest>
